rendered_by: Independently hand-rendered from docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-01-quantara-protocol-v1_1.md and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-02-protocol-v11-c5-freeze.md section 5 without importing any production code or reading the Protocol v1.1 YAML.

semantic_hash_scope.projection_rule: every top-level key except the excluded set
semantic_hash_scope.exclusion_reason: a document cannot contain its own digest

expected_semantic.research_question: Can pre-registered BTC derivatives, spot/perpetual divergence, ETH cross-market state, and one independent BTC venue improve probability forecasts of unusually large BTCUSDT 24-hour moves beyond a strong causal volatility-persistence baseline?

inventory.description: Kraken XBT/USD spot OHLCVT with interval-start timestamps

canonical_lane_immutability.subject: btcusdt_perp_ohlcv (Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual traded-price OHLCV, 2020-2024, at 1m/1h/1d)
canonical_lane_immutability.rule: The already-canonical Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual traded-price OHLCV lane is immutable input: its published identities, pointers, descriptors, parser identity, manifests, quality evidence, and canonical bytes must not be altered. Protocol packets may read it but never modify it.

rules: Incidental columns in the Binance metrics archive may be retained in the immutable raw object but are not canonical Protocol-v1.1 series and must not enter any feature table.

docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-29-data-slice-013-vision-derivatives-backfill.md is superseded for Protocol v1.1; its top-trader and taker-ratio scope, guessed completeness rules, and combined metrics feature direction are not authorized.

target.origin_convention: For hourly origin t, P[t] is the BTCUSDT perpetual 1h bar close at T - 1 ms and the future endpoint is the 1h bar close at T + 24h - 1 ms.
target.label: Y_t    = 1[Z_t > k]
target.threshold: k = Z_(j), where j = ceil(0.80 * N), on eligible 2020-2021 design origins only

quantile.label: Y_t = 1[Z_t > k]
quantile.fixture_binding_rule: The synthetic quantile fixture and the frozen k fixture and its hash must exist and be committed before any 2022-2024 scoring. Protocol v1.1 freezes the threshold method, never the threshold value: k is derived from design data and is therefore outside this document's semantic identity.

target.threshold_design_rule: An origin enters the nearest-rank calculation only when its complete forward label ends no later than 2021-12-31 23:59:59.999 UTC. No 2022 value may enter threshold design.
target.threshold_fixed_rule: k stays fixed through every fold and through sealed 2025
target.quantile_alternatives: Type 7 and Type 8 are defensible alternatives but nearest-rank is selected as the generalized inverse empirical CDF without an interpolated threshold.

realized_volatility.definition: RV_H = sqrt(sum of squared eligible hourly log returns over H hours)
realized_volatility.invalid_window_rule: A zero or incomplete window is invalid; no epsilon replacement is permitted.

feature_formulas.funding_24h_sum: sum settled rates with T-24h < settlement_ts <= T
feature_formulas.native_premium_1h_mean: arithmetic mean of the 60 native-premium 1m closes ending in (T-1h, T]
feature_formulas.eth_rv_24h: sqrt(sum of the 24 eligible ETH hourly log returns ending at T)
feature_formulas.kraken_rv_24h: sqrt(sum of the 24 eligible Kraken hourly log returns ending at T)

feature_window_completeness: Every formula requires its full endpoint/path window.
Funding requires a cadence-complete settlement window.
OI requires the exact five-minute snapshots ending at both endpoints and no intervening gap.
Return/RV windows crossing any invalid source interval are null. There is no stale-value tolerance, interpolation, nearest timestamp, or alternate horizon.

dislocation_roles.rule: Native Binance premium is the pre-registered primary futures-dislocation feature. Constructed mark/index - 1 and mark/spot - 1 are diagnostics only and never enter M1-M4. Mark and index are canonicalized because they verify source integrity and support diagnostics, not because they earn independent model stages.

M1.definition: B2 plus frozen BTC derivatives block

M2.definition: M1 plus BTC perpetual versus Binance spot dislocation

M2K.definition: M2 plus frozen four-column Kraken block

M3.definition: M2 plus frozen ETH family, excluding ETH OI

M3b.definition: M3 plus ETH dlog_oi_24h on the identical post-2021-12-01 common sample

M4.definition: M3 plus frozen Kraken cross-venue family

model_mandates.mandatory_rule: M2 must pass the complete gate versus paired B2 before 2025 can unlock
model_mandates.optional_family_rule: Starting from M2, evaluate the ETH block and then the Kraken block as the only optional additions.
model_mandates.m3b_role: M3b/ETH OI is a secondary diagnostic and can never alter the retained candidate; ETH OI is M3b common-sample only.
model_mandates.final_rule: The resulting candidate must still pass the complete 2%-versus-B2 and calibration gate before 2025.

cross_quote_dislocation_policy.rule: log(Binance BTCUSDT spot close / Kraken XBT/USD close) uses no invented USD/USDT FX conversion; the feature is explicitly a cross-venue, cross-quote dislocation and may include quote-currency (USDT-versus-USD) effects.

expected_semantic.fit_failure_propagation: Any fit failure fails the affected candidate comparison and never drops a fold, year, or candidate from pooling.

calibration.family: unpenalized two-parameter Decimal logistic fit of y on logit(p) with an intercept
calibration.probability_clamp_rule: clamp_mu is mandatory before taking the logarithm
calibration.predictor: x_i = ln(p_i / (1 - p_i)) after the mandatory clamp
failure_conditions: single-class outcome in the calibration sample
zero-variance logit(p), surfacing as exact-zero std or zero pivot
undefined logit, reachable only if the mandatory clamp is bypassed
singular solve, surfacing as zero pivot
separation, identified by positive eta_clamp_count in the calibration fit
calibration.eta_clamp_rule: A positive eta_clamp_count is reported for every fit and is diagnostic rather than a model-fit failure; in calibration it fails calibration_degenerate_logit.
calibration.diagnostic_only: These calculations never alter predictions or pooled Brier estimates.

search_and_calibration_restrictions.calibration_evaluation: Calibration is evaluated on the raw logistic probabilities.
search_and_calibration_restrictions.paired_comparison_rule: For every paired candidate comparison, refit the comparator on exactly the same training rows and score exactly the same test timestamps as the candidate. A larger baseline sample may be reported separately but cannot be used for the paired incremental claim.

point_in_time.cutoff_convention: An hourly information cutoff T is an exact UTC hour boundary. prediction_ts = T + 2 ms. P[t] is the BTC perpetual 1h bar close at T - 1 ms and its future endpoint is the close at T + 24h - 1 ms. These logical ticks order completed data and do not claim exchange network latency.
point_in_time.kline_eligibility: For a kline with source close time C, nominal eligibility_ts = C + 1 ms.
point_in_time.funding_eligibility: For settled funding with settlement time F, nominal eligibility_ts = F + 1 ms.
point_in_time.oi_eligibility: For a five-minute OI row with provider timestamp O under oi_timestamp_resolution role UNRESOLVED_CONSERVATIVE, nominal eligibility_ts = O + 5 minutes.
point_in_time.kraken_eligibility: For Kraken hourly OHLCVT with interval-start timestamp K, nominal eligibility_ts = K + 1 hour.
point_in_time.join_rule: All joins are backward as-of joins on eligibility_ts; eligibility_ts < prediction_ts without exception.
point_in_time.funding_boundary_repair: When F = T, funding eligibility T + 1 ms is strictly before prediction T + 2 ms; Protocol v1 used T + 1 ms for both and therefore contradicted its funding window.
point_in_time.same_boundary_effect: The added tick changes same-boundary inclusion for funding only. Completed klines, five-minute OI, and Kraken hourly candles are already eligible no later than T.
point_in_time.boundary_test_rule: universal convention change; boundary-test every source
point_in_time.live_latency_rule: Production use requires measured publication and ingestion latency. If it exceeds the decision schedule, same-boundary funding shifts to the next live decision.

rejected_alternatives.eligibility_at_f: coherent but removes the frozen after-settlement ordering tick
rejected_alternatives.funding_window_before_t: causal but delays boundary settlements one hourly decision

point_in_time.archive_publication_ts_role: ex-post provenance, not real-time observation availability
point_in_time.limitation: Protocol v1.1 claims nominal historical point-in-time safety, not reconstruction of historical network latency. This limitation must appear in every result report.

rules: No price, mark, index, premium, OI, or venue gap is interpolated.
A feature is invalid when a required lookback crosses a missing native interval.
A label is invalid when its required BTC price endpoints/path are unavailable.
Known pre-archive periods remain null and receive no fabricated regime flag.
Exact duplicate source rows may be deterministically deduplicated only after byte comparison, with source-row count, distinct-row count, duplicate count, and duplicate hashes preserved.
ETH OI before 2021-12-01 is null and never enters M3.

coverage_and_claim_scope.applies_to: Every candidate in the frozen ladder and every optional-family hypothesis, in every scored period.
coverage_and_claim_scope.no_threshold_reason: the audit rejected the unsupported arbitrary 98 percent cutoff
coverage_and_claim_scope.threshold_addition_rule: Any future minimum requires separate justification and preregistration and is never a Protocol v1 or v1.1 correction.
coverage_and_claim_scope.paired_comparison_rule: Coverage is reported on the paired sample actually scored, never on a larger comparator sample.

exclusion_reason_vocabulary.assignment_rule: first applicable member in listed order
exclusion_reason_vocabulary.mutual_exclusivity: exactly one reason per excluded row
exclusion_reason_vocabulary.count_identity: counts by reason sum to total excluded rows

reasons.definition: a required lookback crosses a missing native interval
a formula's full endpoint or path window is unavailable
the settlement window is not cadence-complete
a required five-minute OI snapshot is missing or an intervening gap exists
a required BTC price endpoint or path is unavailable
a required 2026 target-only buffer bar is absent
a known pre-archive period is null and unflagged
ETH OI before 2021-12-01 never enters M3

longest_missing_run.domain: the candidate's nominal hourly grid for the period
longest_missing_run.boundary_rule: Runs do not span a year boundary; report per year and pooled as the maximum of the per-year runs.
longest_missing_run.tie_rule: report the length only; no start timestamp is required
longest_missing_run.effect: diagnostic only; never changes eligibility, pooling weights, or a gate outcome

fold_rules: Training origin O is eligible iff O + 24h <= S.
Apply only frozen train-window z-score and fixed regularization.
No clipping or post-hoc calibration is allowed.

calibration_diagnostics.method: unpenalized logistic regression of y on logit(p) with an intercept
calibration_diagnostics.clamp: clamp p to [0.000000000001, 0.999999999999] only for the logarithm
calibration_diagnostics.note: Diagnostic only; these calculations do not alter predictions.

bootstrap.method: frozen year-stratified paired non-circular moving-block bootstrap

estimand.observed_statistic: D_obs = pooled hourly mean over paired-valid d_t

nominal_grid.construction: complete nominal hourly UTC grid separately for each calendar year
nominal_grid.hours_formula: H_y = UTC hours from January 1 of year y to January 1 of year y+1
nominal_grid.paired_valid_storage: d_t on paired-valid hours and null otherwise
nominal_grid.missing_policy: retain null positions; never fill a missing loss value

bootstrap.draw_order: years ascending, then blocks in index order
bootstrap.truncation_rule: concatenate blocks including nulls and truncate to exactly H_y clock-hour positions
bootstrap.null_preservation: blocks retain their observed null pattern
bootstrap.pooling_formula: D* = sum of non-null resampled d_t across years / pooled resampled paired-valid count
bootstrap.pooling_weight: resampled paired-valid count, not year count or nominal hours

p_value.null_centering: d0_t = d_t - D_obs on paired-valid hours; nulls stay null

fail_closed.observed_year: fewer than 168 paired-valid observations in any required year
fail_closed.replicate_year: no paired-valid observation in any required year for a replicate

prng.arithmetic: exact unsigned 64-bit with masking after state advance and multiplications
prng.bounded_draw: rejection sampling below(bound); bare modulo is forbidden

arithmetic.input: integer scaled by 1e-18 or Decimal exactly representable at that quantum
arithmetic.rendering: quantize only final report to 18 decimal places with ROUND_HALF_EVEN

bootstrap.dependence_correction: 168-clock-hour blocks preserve serial dependence from overlapping 24-hour labels
bootstrap.disclosed_design_change: Protocol v1.1 increases resamples from 2000 to 20000 as an inferential strengthening

success_gate.unlock_rule: The frozen candidate may unlock 2025 only if all criteria hold.

criteria.rule: bootstrap 95% lower bound for BS_B2 - BS_candidate is greater than zero
positive Brier improvement in at least two validation years
pooled absolute probability bias is at most 0.02
pooled calibration slope is between 0.8 and 1.2
yearly absolute probability bias is at most 0.04

optional_family_retention.holm_assignment_rule: Sort all three observed p-values ascending, assign thresholds by sorted rank, reject while p_(i) is at most alpha / (m - i + 1), and stop at the first failure.
retention_criteria: pooled relative Brier improvement versus the currently retained model is at least 0.01
unadjusted two-sided 95% paired-bootstrap interval has a lower bound above zero
one-sided bootstrap p-value passes ordinary Holm across the three-test family
at least two validation years improve
no validation year is worse than -0.02

decision_graph.eth_passes: retain M4 only if H_K_M3 also passes; otherwise retain M3
decision_graph.eth_fails: retain M2K only if H_K_M2 passes; otherwise retain M2

optional_family_retention.fallback: If ETH is rejected, compare Kraken against M2, not against an ETH-containing model.
optional_family_retention.m3b_role: M3b is an identical-common-sample secondary diagnostic and can never alter the retained candidate.
optional_family_retention.rejected_block_rule: A rejected block receives no alternative transformation search.
optional_family_retention.retained_candidate_gate: The retained candidate must still pass the complete seven-criterion success_gate versus paired B2 before 2025 unlocks.
optional_family_retention.selection_reason: The optional family uses the same 2022-2024 validation data to select among candidates, so its improvement estimates are conditioned on that selection.
optional_family_retention.disclosed_design_change: Protocol v1.1 corrects the draft optional-family size from two tests to three tests so ordinary Holm covers the complete retention graph.

lineage.earlier_mvp: BTCUSDT perpetual decisions every completed 15-minute candle, fixed one-hour immediate-entry policy, logistic or return regression primary, LightGBM secondary, and predictive plus after-cost economic metrics.
lineage.supersession: Protocol v1 intentionally changed to undirected 24-hour large-move probability, hourly cadence, no trading-policy or PnL layer, and exact-Decimal logistic ladder.
lineage.reintroduction_rule: LightGBM, XGBoost, return regression, directional actions, or economic gates require a separately preregistered successor experiment.

oi_timestamp_resolution.provider_timestamp_preservation: Preserve create_time natively; do not relabel it as interval_open_ts or interval_close_ts while its archive-specific semantics remain unresolved.
oi_timestamp_resolution.both_readings_safety: If O denotes the start of a five-minute interval, O + 5 minutes is exactly its completion; if O denotes the end, the same rule is five minutes conservative. The arithmetic is causally safe under both readings.
oi_timestamp_resolution.latest_eligible_at_hourly_boundary: Under eligibility_ts < prediction_ts = T + 2 ms, the latest eligible row has O = T - 5 minutes.
oi_timestamp_resolution.resolution_obligation: Before OI canonicalization, perform an archive-specific create_time semantics check and record measured or cited evidence in the source contract; until then the role remains UNRESOLVED_CONSERVATIVE.
oi_timestamp_resolution.disclosed_limitation: Every result report using an OI feature must disclose the unresolved provider timestamp semantics and the conservative eligibility treatment.
oi_timestamp_resolution.kraken_asymmetry: Kraken documents candle timestamps as interval starts; its timestamp role and K + 1 hour eligibility remain frozen and must not be harmonized with OI.

final_refit.identical_sample_rule: Refit the retained candidate and paired B2 on the same origin set: the retained candidate's point-in-time complete-case origins. B2 receives no larger sample.
final_refit.standardization_refit_rule: Recompute z-score means and population standard deviations on exactly the final refit rows; carry no standardization from any fold.
final_refit.target_k_rule: Keep the value frozen from the pre-2022 design set; never recompute k in the final refit.
final_refit.nominal_vs_eligible: 37969 is the nominal hourly-origin count satisfying the purge inequality; the realized point-in-time complete-case count is smaller and unknown until execution.
final_refit.fit_failure_propagation: Never drop a fold, year, or candidate from pooling after a final fit failure.

target_endpoint_buffer_2026.purpose: Supply 24-hour label endpoints for the 23 calendar-2025 origins whose labels end in 2026.
target_endpoint_buffer_2026.target_only_proof: Because prediction_ts = T + 2 ms and the join is strict, every eligible feature row for a 2025 origin has eligibility_ts <= T + 1 ms; no 2026 row of any series can be a feature for a 2025 origin.
target_endpoint_buffer_2026.hard_end_boundary: Refuse any 1h bar with open at or after 2026-01-01 23:00:00.000 UTC; emitting that bar is a contract violation, not an ignorable extra row.
target_endpoint_buffer_2026.truncation_rule: After parsing and before aggregation, discard every 1m row whose open is outside [2026-01-01 00:00:00.000, 2026-01-01 22:59:00.000] UTC inclusive.
target_endpoint_buffer_2026.discarded_rows_rule: Count and report discarded rows; never use them for any purpose.
target_endpoint_buffer_2026.cannot_widen: The permitted extent is exactly the 23 stated bars; acquiring more 2026 data for convenience is a contract violation even if extra rows would not be used.
target_endpoint_buffer_2026.missing_data_rule: A missing required buffer bar invalidates and excludes the affected origin as an incomplete case; shorter horizons, nearest bars, and 1d substitution are forbidden.

replication_gate_2025.scope: Complete retained candidate versus paired B2 on all point-in-time complete-case eligible calendar-2025 origins.

criteria.rule: two-sided 95% bootstrap CI lower bound for BS_B2 - BS_candidate > 0
calibration slope is within the frozen C3 helper default band
calibration regression is defined and converges

dropped_multi_year_criteria.reason: at least two improving years is unattainable in one calendar year
the one-year BSS threshold of 0.02 implies the minus-0.02 worst-year bound
the one-year absolute-bias bound of 0.02 implies the 0.04 yearly bound

calibration_reuse.probability_clamp_rule: clamp_mu is mandatory before taking the logarithm
calibration_reuse.criterion_5_rule: satisfied only when the calibration fit is defined and converges

replication_gate_2025.claim_scope: REPLICATED means the complete retained frozen model replicated aggregate probability-forecast improvement versus paired B2 in calendar 2025; it does not establish replication of any individual ETH or Kraken feature.
replication_gate_2025.component_claim_rule: A block claim requires its own frozen parent comparison to satisfy the same five criteria; the component chain is scored once as claim-specific diagnostics.
